title: Block-hierarchical covariance decompositions for finite-block additive functionals
summary: We study additive functionals of stationary Markov chains whose observables depend on a fixed finite block of consecutive states. Such block observables arise naturally in sliding-window statistics, pattern counts, and local dependence analysis. In the independent setting, additive functionals of overlapping finite blocks are known to have a covariance operator with integer spectrum \(0,1,\ldots,k\), and the eigenvalue-one component represents the information first detectable at block length \(k\). We study the corresponding problem when the underlying sequence is a stationary Markov chain.…
